environmentNote: matplotlib was installed into diffsinger-model-env to satisfy an unused Agg-backend import in the pinned upstream utils module. The host was otherwise unchanged.
claims: Proves the pinned MiniNSF generator instantiates and exports at SEAM profile, outputs the exact expected sample count for 1/3/16/23 frames, and matches PyTorch within float32 tolerance in ONNX Runtime. It does not prove GAN training, a vocoder qualification, an admitted bundle or any singing quality.
stderrInterpretation: stderr holds three toolchain warnings, not failures: a torch weight_norm deprecation, a notice that the legacy TorchScript ONNX exporter is still the default, and unapplied constant folding for opset>=10 Slice steps. The export succeeded and ONNX Runtime executed the graph in all four cases.
